figures.caption: Sequence-based phylogenetic analysis of PrAMPs with available crystal structures. Variation in the peptide sequences was evaluated by net charge (orange), length in the number of amino acid residues (raspberry), and percent proline (deep blue).

Cell-based expression of antimicrobial peptides. Onc variants were engineered with truncations at the C terminus and substitutions with Lys and Arg at positions 4 and 7, respectively. The plasmid pKan5tvVec containing TEV recognition, peptide, and TEV protease sequences were transformed into DH5α. Induction with l-arabinose enabled production of a free peptide upon cleavage of the C-terminal amino acids of the TEV recognition sequence (ENLYFQ) by TEV protease. Inhibition of bacterial growth was monitored to determine antibacterial activity.

In cellulo DMS probing of PTC and H89. Nucleotides exhibiting reduced DMS activity in the presence of peptides are (A) mapped on the secondary structure (E. coli numbering), circled in red, and (B) quantified by the relative band intensity for each Onc variant.

(A) The result of docking with Onc14 P4K,L7R (orange) and Tth70S (PDB: 4Z8C) is shown. The side chain of Lys4 is within hydrogen-bonding distance of residue A76 of the deacylated P-site tRNA (raspberry). (B) The docked structure from panel (A) containing the uncharged P-site tRNA was used to align the preattack ribosome complex (PDB: 1VY4) with a charged P-site tRNAfMet (blue) and A-site tRNAPhe (green), which was followed by superimposition of the variant peptide (Onc14 P4K,L7R), which reveals a steric clash with the Lys side chain and A76.

Ecoli70SEC (pink, PDB: 6O9J) aligned to Tth70S-OncΔ14–19 (raspberry, PDB: 4Z8C). Superimposition of OncΔ14–19 reveals differences in the sequence and conformation of ribosomal nucleotides and proteins between T. thermophilus and E. coli with (A) a base-stacked orientation of C2612 and N-terminally truncated uL32 and (B) the substitution of His69 with Gly64 in uL4.

Bacterial 23S rRNA MSA visualized using modeled Ecoli70SEC in complex with Onc (orange). Per nucleotide conservation is depicted by corresponding percent ranges: 99–100% (white), 95–98.99% (violet), 90–94.99% (dark violet), 75–89.99% (blue), 50–74.99% (teal), and <50% (green). The 30S subunit (gray) and P-site tRNA (yellow) are shown as outlined silhouettes to visualize underlying nucleotides. Ribosomal proteins and 5S rRNA were omitted from the visualization.

Percent conservation of 23S rRNA nucleotides within 8 Å of docked Onc14 P4K,L7R (orange) modeled with Ecoli70SEC. Nucleotides hindering visualization of underlying residues are represented as transparent silhouettes with opaque dashed lines and the corresponding conservation colors. Ribosomal protein 4 (uL4) residues within 8 Å of Onc14 P4K,L7R are colored in dark gray. Color coding of conservation percentages is depicted as previously described.
